# ORBYT ONWARD

> ORBYT ONWARD (short form: ORBYT) is a software development and digital systems company based in Bangladesh. We build connected digital systems combining software engineering, AI automation, and measurable digital growth.

## Entity Information
- Official Name: ORBYT ONWARD
- Short Brand Name: ORBYT
- Official Website: https://orbytonward.tech
- Canonical Identifier: https://orbytonward.tech/#organization
- Primary Business Category: Software Development Company
- Geographic Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Leadership: Tasbir Kabir (Founder & Lead Systems Architect)
- Core Positioning: "ORBYT ONWARD builds connected digital systems by combining software engineering, AI, automation, marketing, and creative execution."
- Philosophy: "Build better. Connect everything. Move forward." / "Strategy before execution." / "Measurement from day one."

## Core Services
1. Custom Software Development: Bespoke web applications, internal operations tools, role-based portals, and PostgreSQL database schemas designed around proprietary business workflows. (https://orbytonward.tech/services/custom-software-development)
2. Web Development & Web Applications: Production-grade web applications built with Next.js and TypeScript, focused on sub-second rendering, accessibility, and high conversion throughput. (https://orbytonward.tech/services/web-development)
3. SaaS Development: Full-lifecycle software-as-a-service architecture, multi-tenant databases, subscription billing engines, and usage metering. (https://orbytonward.tech/services/saas-development)
4. AI Development & Workflow Automation: Autonomous LLM pipelines, automated document processing, CRM webhooks, and workflow automation connecting disconnected software. (https://orbytonward.tech/services/ai-automation)
5. Performance Marketing & Media Buying: Technical ad operations, server-side conversion tracking (CAPI), and unit-economics media buying. (https://orbytonward.tech/services/performance-marketing)
6. Video Editing & Creative Production: High-retention video post-production, motion graphics, and commercial assets. (https://orbytonward.tech/services/video-editing)

## Verified Case Studies
- Sadia's IELTS Academy (https://orbytonward.tech/work/sadias-ielts): High-converting Next.js web application and automated admissions routing for Bangladesh's premier IELTS mentoring brand. Live deployment: https://sadiasielts.com/ (Measured: 0.38s Largest Contentful Paint, +44% Admissions conversion lift).
